text_block_list.text:
Pure bliiiss♪ Pure bliiiss♪ Just the right temperature~♪
An o~asis in the shopping district~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Since it was my day off,
I went to the public bath in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hit the sauna, hop in the massage chair...
and chug down some carrot milk!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take you along next time, Trainer-san.
Work out all that stiffness in your tired body♪"
